name: Magnetosphere Field Line Tracing
definition: Traces a single magnetospheric field line from an ionospheric footpoint using a fixed-step Euler method along the normalised B-field vector. The field line terminates when it reaches the magnetopause surface or the ionospheric surface (r < 1.1 R_E).
summary: Magnetosphere Field Line Tracing visualizes Earth's magnetic topology by integrating a dipole model from the ionosphere to the magnetopause, distinct from general tracing by its specific boundary conditions.
